decision.analysis: Round 1 results show tiny_cnn_baseline (val_acc=0.9762) clearly outperforms compact_transformer (0.9455) and ViT (0.8788). Critically, all three models were still improving at epoch 3 when early stopping triggered (patience=2), indicating under-training. The tiny_cnn learning curve shows steady gains: 0.937→0.961→0.976, suggesting it hasn't plateaued. For round 2, I'll (1) refine the tiny_cnn with depth=3 (the max allowed for 28×28 without excessive downsampling), wider channels (96), and a slightly longer patience to let it converge; and (2) substantially upgrade the compact_transformer from hidden=48 to hidden=128 with 3 layers, higher weight decay (0.01), and class weighting enabled, since the prior config was under-capacity and under-regularized for a transformer. Both get the full 6-epoch budget with patience=3 to avoid premature stopping.

candidates.rationale: Refined tiny_cnn building on the best round-1 result (0.9762). Depth reduced to 3 (max valid for 28x28) to avoid over-downsampling while retaining 3 conv-pool stages. Hidden widened from 64 to 96 for ~50% more channel capacity without overfitting at 90K samples. Dropout relaxed to 0.15 since the wider channels provide implicit regularization. Added contrast augmentation alongside hflip+brightness for stronger photometric diversity. Patience increased to 3 (from 2) because the round-1 curve was still rising at epoch 3, indicating the model needs more epochs to converge. Cosine schedule with eta_min=0 ensures the LR decays smoothly over the 6-epoch budget. Class weighting retained for the 1.63x imbalance.

Substantially upgraded compact_transformer. Round-1 used hidden=48 (only 12 per head) which is severely under-capacity for modeling pathology texture. Now hidden=128 (32 per head with 4 heads), depth=3 (was 2), mlp_ratio=4 (was 3). Weight decay raised to 0.01 (standard for AdamW transformers) to prevent attention weight blowup. Class weighting enabled (was off) to address imbalance. Label smoothing increased to 0.1 for better calibration on 9 classes. LR reduced to 3e-4 (from 5e-4) since the larger model is more sensitive to LR spikes in early training. Attention pooling retained as it outperformed mean/cls in round 1. Patience=3 to allow convergence. The conv tokenizer (patch_size=4, tokenizer_layers=2) produces 49 tokens of dim 128, giving the attention layers sufficient spatial context while staying under 4M params.

Choose epochs and all active hyperparameters, including early_stopping_patience (0 disables stopping), early_stopping_monitor and early_stopping_min_delta. Epochs is the desired horizon: exploration caps it at epoch_budget; finalists receive the same maximum_epochs ceiling. Patience is never silently shortened.
